domain_title: Data, privacy, confidentiality and intellectual property
title: Unverified rights and output ownership
canonical_definition: Accessible content is assumed to be available for AI use, transformation or redistribution without rights analysis.

conditions: When third-party, customer, employee, open-source or generated content is used or distributed.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Unverified rights and output ownership: Accessible content is assumed to be available for AI use, transformation or redistribution without rights analysis.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show scraped material without rights review, confidential tuning data, or generated output claimed as proprietary without review?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Unverified rights and output ownership, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: Generated output is claimed as proprietary without review

conditions: Refer verified unverified rights and output ownership to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.1 (PDF p. 27), GOVERN 6.1 (PDF p. 29), MAP 4.1 (PDF p. 32)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on identifying legal requirements and third-party intellectual-property risk. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where access to an asset is treated as permission to train, transform or distribute it. The mechanism can have an operational effect where an observed ingestion or distribution record conflicts with a documented restriction, or a material asset bypasses the rights decision.
potential_consequences: Unreviewed use or distribution can exceed the organization’s available rights.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether access to an asset is treated as permission to train, transform or distribute it. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether an observed ingestion or distribution record conflicts with a documented restriction, or a material asset bypasses the rights decision. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review a trace of representative inputs and outputs through permissions, review, transformations and publication decisions. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether access to an asset is treated as permission to train, transform or distribute it. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether an observed ingestion or distribution record conflicts with a documented restriction, or a material asset bypasses the rights decision. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide a trace of representative inputs and outputs through permissions, review, transformations and publication decisions. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: A trace of representative inputs and outputs through permissions, review, transformations and publication decisions.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether access to an asset is treated as permission to train, transform or distribute it, and separately check whether an observed ingestion or distribution record conflicts with a documented restriction, or a material asset bypasses the rights decision. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use a trace of representative inputs and outputs through permissions, review, transformations and publication decisions. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: A verified license or exception can support limited use within its actual terms and scope.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in B5 alone cannot establish AP-B5 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows unverified rights and output ownership
Implementation or operating evidence shows unverified rights and output ownership
Presence or tested absence of unverified rights and output ownership is unresolved within scope
